'''Health and environment'''
*[[Air pollution in Delhi]]
**The [[Government of Delhi|government]] of [[Delhi]], [[India]], introduces stricter [[pollution control]]s, including [[double parking]] fees, [[remote work]] arrangements, [[Emission standards in India|restrictions]] on high-emission vehicles, and bans on dust-producing [[Construction industry in India|construction]], as [[PM2.5|PM{{sub|2.5}}]] levels reach 201 micrograms per cubic metre. *[[2026 European unrest]]
**[[2026 Portuguese housing protests]]
***[[Portugal|Portuguese]] [[Special Operations Group (Portugal)|riot police]] dismantle [[protest camp]]s in [[Lisbon]]'s [[Rossio Square]] and [[Porto]], arresting 13 people for refusing orders to disperse. **The [[United States]] [[Federal Bureau of Investigation]] says [[North Korea]] orchestrated the hack and theft of over $6 billion of [[cryptocurrency]] from [[cryptocurrency exchange|exchange]] [[Binance]], facilitated through the [[Lazarus Group]], which also hacked [[Dubai]]-based exchange [[Bybit]] last year. [https://www.dw.com/en/fbi-says-north-korea-behind-6-billion-binance-crypto-theft/a-79819998 (DW)]
